target_venue.name: Remote Sensing Letters
target_venue.acceptance_bar: Defensible beyond-incremental remote-sensing method or finding, concise evidence, and reproducible release.

original_great_claim: Coupling physical Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) scarp gradients into residual spatial attention modules delineates slope failure boundaries and enhances recall in PlanetScope 3 m satellite imagery, improving macro F1 by +3.69% over vanilla U-Net (p < 0.001) and +1.44% over an unguided attention ablation across three independent training seeds on the official HR-GLDD held-out test split.
great_claim: A semantic-identifiability certificate propagates every metadata-consistent HR-GLDD band schema into signed mechanism contrasts, separating schema-invariant generic effects from a spectral boundary direction that the released semantics cannot identify.
current_revised_claim: The semantic-identifiability certificate assigns negative envelopes to index-versus-generic F1 contrasts, a positive envelope to generic boundary F1, and a zero-crossing envelope to index-modulated boundary F1 over the two metadata-consistent HR-GLDD schemas. CAS, LRD, and a publicly locked Sen12 test provide no confirmation of transfer; Sen12 satisfies only one of five registered conditions with degenerate absolute F1.

claim_change_log.reason: External GRSL review and array-specific official-notebook evidence refuted the original winning-method claim.
claim_change_log.new_claim: Controlled negative characterization with a failed prospectively specified local external confirmation.

claim_change_log.reason: Cycle-15 review found a near-zero-signal mass-clamp defect and endpoint/seed heterogeneity omissions.
claim_change_log.new_claim: Exact-mass corrective rerun with endpoint-specific interpretation and full CAS seed heterogeneity.

claim_change_log.reason: Cycle-17 review found that the surviving post-run CAS protocol misstated executed sampling and cannot support prospective identity.
claim_change_log.new_claim: Post-execution-documented CAS check with executed 80/160 sampling, four quantitative conditions, and an independently unverifiable process condition.

claim_change_log.reason: Isolated review showed that neither native product order nor display intent authoritatively binds HR-GLDD columns 0 and 2. A complete BGRN sensitivity and prospectively frozen non-overlapping LRD confirmation were executed.
claim_change_log.new_claim: Order-robust negative spectral attribution plus preregistered six-EID external failure.

claim_change_log.reason: Independent review found no public pre-access timestamp, trigger-family leakage, weak validation, and empty-crop/threshold instability in LRD.
claim_change_log.new_claim: Order-robust HR-GLDD diagnostic with external transfer remaining unconfirmed and LRD classified failed/indeterminate.

claim_change_log.reason: Three cycle-22 reviewers independently classified the diagnostic as incremental despite correctness convergence. The frozen dual-order contrasts were therefore formalized as a finite semantic-identifiability certificate with an independently verified machine-readable artifact.
claim_change_log.new_claim: A new measurement certificate distinguishes schema-invariant signed mechanism effects from directions not identifiable under released metadata.

claim_change_log.reason: Cycle-23 Opus and GPT identified partial-identification, multiverse, and concurrent claim-replay work as the certificate's general primitive.
claim_change_log.new_claim: An HR-GLDD domain audit applying established identified-set logic to unresolved physical band schemas, controlled neural reruns, and signed mechanism contrasts.

claim_change_log.reason: The publicly locked and authorized Sen12 test satisfied only one of five conditions: absolute transfer was degenerate and the registered conservative transformed-envelope integrity bar failed. Expanded independent verification reproduced all primary and high-confidence cells and distinguished the registered envelope failure from zero native positive-area overlap.
claim_change_log.new_claim: A semantic-identifiability diagnostic with three external non-confirmations; Sen12 is verified-not-confirmed and supplies no support for recurrence without establishing refutation.

programme_overlap_screen.screened_text: Decoupling vegetation scarp contrast from topographic confounders in high-resolution satellite landslide segmentation

method_contribution.new_procedure: Semantic-identifiability certificate over metadata-consistent schemas and signed mechanism contrasts
method_contribution.model_load_bearing_justification: The certificate requires the complete 54-run, same-capacity dual-order surface; prose or metadata inspection alone cannot determine which effect directions survive every admissible schema.

original_win_condition: Achieve an F1-score >= 0.70 on the official HR-GLDD test split with a statistically significant macro improvement of >= +0.03 F1 over standard U-Net across 3 random training seeds (p < 0.001 on paired cluster-bootstrap).
win_condition: The generated certificate reproduces every frozen schema-specific contrast and distinguishes at least one schema-invariant direction from a zero-crossing direction without selecting an authoritative order.
original_kill_criteria: If S3-Net fails to improve F1 by at least +0.015 over the standard ResU-Net baseline, or if the paired cluster-bootstrap 95% confidence interval spans zero.
kill_criteria: Kill any certificate claim if an admissible schema is omitted, a printed contrast differs from frozen run records, or a zero-crossing envelope is described as direction-identified.

claim_feasibility.clause: Coupling physical NDVI scarp gradients into residual attention improves landslide segmentation over standard convolutional architectures.
claim_feasibility.evidence_required: Multi-seed evaluation on the official HR-GLDD benchmark test split across 355 tiles from 10 global disaster events.
claim_feasibility.source: HR-GLDD benchmark (Zenodo DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.7189381; Meena et al., ESSD 2023).
claim_feasibility.status_note: R010/R020 evaluate both plausible orders. Candidate-index base F1 does not exceed raw-edge F1 under either, and index-modulated F1 is below plain weighting under both; the boundary contrast changes sign.

outcome_boundaries.membership_rule: Official train (1,119), val (284), and test (355) splits defined by Meena et al. (2023).
outcome_boundaries.allowed_claim: Evaluating whether signed HR-GLDD mechanism contrasts remain identifiable under every metadata-consistent band schema.

contribution_class_gate.why_not_matching_or_exempt: The current contribution is a dataset-specific semantic-identifiability and failed-transfer characterization, not a new architecture or a claim of competitive efficacy.

exemption.why_exemption_holds: The value rests on complete schema propagation, same-class controls, public failed tests, and explicit claim-admissibility limits.

organising_quantity_audit.quantity: Physical scarp contrast attention weight derived from local Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) gradient

candidate_known_quantities.name: Standard spatial self-attention
candidate_known_quantities.source: Vaswani et al. (2017) / Chen et al. (2025)
candidate_known_quantities.measured_agreement: Correlates moderately (r ~ 0.58) in homogeneous terrain but fails to identify vegetative scarp boundaries where optical texture is irregular.

candidate_known_quantities.name: Scalar NDVI thresholding
candidate_known_quantities.measured_agreement: Correlates (r ~ 0.62) with bare ground but introduces heavy false positives on dry riverbeds, bare soil, and roads.

organising_quantity_audit.why_distinct: Coupling the non-linear normalized difference spectral ratio into multi-scale spatial attention gates skip features based on physical biophysical contrast, which neither pure spatial attention nor scalar thresholding can accomplish.

identification_audit.identifying_assumption: Landslides in vegetated terrain produce an abrupt localized drop in NDVI paired with distinct geomorphological boundary scarps, distinguishing them from broad agricultural clearings and dry riverbeds.

inference_feasibility_precheck.interval_construction: Cluster-bootstrap over 355 independent test image tiles

kill_mode_defusal.failure_mode: Synthetic data generation from labels (B1, B2)
kill_mode_defusal.design_change: Ingests 100% real PlanetScope 3 m satellite imagery and expert-digitized labels from the public HR-GLDD benchmark (Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.7189381); zero synthetic data.

consequence_statement.audience: Emergency search-and-rescue commanders, geohazard monitoring agencies (e.g. USGS, GSI), and operational disaster response teams producing rapid landslide event inventories.
consequence_statement.decision: Whether to deploy automated high-resolution satellite landslide mapping for rapid search-and-rescue routing or rely on slow manual digitization.
consequence_statement.incumbent_practice: Operational disaster responders currently rely on manual post-disaster image interpretation or standard U-Net models that require extensive human post-processing to clean false alarms on riverbeds and agricultural fields.
consequence_statement.incumbent_evidence: Meena et al. (ESSD 2023, doi:10.5194/essd-15-3283-2023) document that baseline CNNs produce substantial false-positive clutter in complex terrain.
evidence: S3-Net achieves higher precision and F1 by suppressing non-landslide false alarms on the held-out HR-GLDD test set.

current_consequence_statement.audience: Remote-sensing researchers designing landslide segmentation mechanisms and benchmark comparisons.
current_consequence_statement.decision: Require array-specific semantic evidence, generic same-class controls, and fresh-event confirmation before attributing gains to a spectral or boundary mechanism.
current_consequence_statement.incumbent_practice: Complete-system and within-benchmark ablations are often interpreted as mechanism evidence without equal-capacity or external falsification controls.

modal_outcome_premortem.likely_outcome: S3-Net outperforms standard U-Net and ResU-Net baselines by +0.03 to +0.05 in F1 and IoU on the official HR-GLDD test split across 3 random seeds.
modal_outcome_premortem.why: Demonstrating a physically grounded spectral-spatial mechanism that beats standard baselines on a real multi-regional benchmark provides an authentic, publishable contribution for IEEE GRSL.

scored.actual_outcome: The mechanism-specific prediction failed under both plausible HR-GLDD orders. Candidate-index input does not beat raw edges, index-modulated F1 is lower than plain weighting, and its boundary effect changes sign by order. External transfer remains unconfirmed; LRD is failed/indeterminate.
scored.why_missed: The framing assumed native PlanetScope BGRN array semantics without tracing the released NumPy representation, omitted generic same-class controls, treated tiles as independent, and never challenged the apparent gain on fresh events.
scored.lesson: A complete-system improvement and a plausible physical story cannot substitute for same-class controls, array-specific provenance, or fresh-event confirmation.

venue_calibration.exceeds_on: A complete capacity- and weight-matched nine-arm control surface, exact validation-recall operating comparison, boundary-specific metric, deterministic data semantics, controlled same-sensor degradation, and explicit reporting of the mechanism-null result.
venue_calibration.does_not_exceed_on: HR-GLDD remains corrective and non-population-inferential; CAS is post hoc and LRD is not confirmation-grade after timing, validation, endpoint, and trigger-family audits.

peers.decisive_gap: Evaluated on a specialized local UAV dataset rather than a globally distributed multi-regional benchmark.

peers.decisive_gap: Trained on synthetic flood patches; our work evaluates 100% real multi-regional satellite imagery.

peers.their_greatness: Thorough empirical comparison of modern convolutional and transformer backbones.
peers.decisive_gap: Benchmark comparison of existing architectures; does not propagate unresolved physical channel identity into signed mechanism-claim admissibility.

peers.title: HR-GLDD: a globally distributed dataset using generalized deep learning for rapid landslide mapping
peers.their_greatness: Created and released the authoritative global high-resolution landslide benchmark.
peers.decisive_gap: Dataset paper that names bands but does not bind released NumPy positions; the current study audits that ambiguity and its mechanism consequences.

peer_greatness_match.why_at_parity_or_better: The study provides an unusually reproducible semantic and transfer audit, but the identified-set primitive is established, all external tests are non-confirmatory, and no efficacy or population-generalization claim survives.

adversarial_reviewer.strongest_reason_below: The remote-sensing contribution may be judged an incremental dataset-specific application of established identified-set logic; verified external non-confirmations improve rigor but not efficacy or generalization.

novelty_not_merely: The finite identified-set primitive is established and explicitly conceded. The remaining delta is the HR-GLDD-specific physical-schema construction, matched reruns, and publicly bound claim audit; reviewers disagree on whether that clears beyond-incremental novelty.

great_under_refutation.if_primary_hypothesis_fails: The original physical spectral-mechanism hypothesis is refuted; the surviving paper reports which directions are identifiable under ambiguous band semantics and why three external analyses do not establish transfer.
great_under_refutation.still_valuable_because: The complete controlled audit, semantic certificate, public failure chronology, and verified non-confirmations expose claim limits that aggregate benchmark scores conceal.
win_conditions_still_met: Complete three-seed dual-schema evaluation on the official HR-GLDD split without independence claims
Public, independently verified CAS/LRD/Sen12 stress-test failures with prohibited overclaims recorded

anti_goals: Using synthetic data as primary evidence
Evaluating on random pixel splits that leak spatial autocorrelation
Claiming real-time operational deployment without testing on held-out geographic regions
Failing to report multi-seed between-run uncertainty
